name: Select playbook
description: Select the most fitting known governed process for carrying out the current intent.
when_to_use: Use after intent/artifact selection when a repeatable governed process may apply.

browser_or_ui_in_scope.description: Whether browser/UI behavior is in scope

playbook_key.instructions: Choose a playbook only when it fits the purpose and state. Browser/UI verification should use browser_ui_verification. Recurring, foundational, or repeatedly patched defects should use root_cause_analysis rather than another symptom patch. Do not treat a proposed/draft title as executable authority. Choose none_required when no playbook is needed. Choose other_needs_new when a governed process is needed but no active playbook fits. Choose unclear_needs_review when the playbook cannot be chosen reliably.

criteria.technical_project_exploration: Explore an unfamiliar technical project/tool and compare viable options.
criteria.research_and_synthesis: Gather targeted sources/evidence and synthesize findings.
criteria.decision_assessment: Evaluate requirements, options, tradeoffs, consequences, and prepare a decision.
criteria.implementation: Carry out authorized implementation with required checks and evidence.
criteria.root_cause_analysis: Diagnose underlying/foundational causes, recurrence, attempts, and systemic prevention.
criteria.browser_ui_verification: Verify UI/UX and functionality through the actual browser/UI, including interaction and relevant console/runtime behavior.
criteria.none_required: No specific playbook is required for this step.
criteria.other_needs_new: A playbook is required but none of the active playbooks fits.
criteria.unclear_needs_review: Current context cannot reliably determine the playbook.
